title: The two finite base-change routes and their prescribed endpoint comparisons
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a coefficient datum C with prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and n >= 1. Let S be a six-functor datum [def-sf-datum] at these coefficients. For a compactified Cartesian square Q=(g prime,f prime,f,g) of its finite-type spaces and K in the full bounded constructible category on X and L in the finite-Tor bounded constructible category on Y, define the following maps using [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. TensorRealization is the inverse coefficient-equivalence unit on the fixed tensor. Mu is the pullback realization, fixed pullback comparison and TensorRealization followed by the canonical fixed pullback/tensor comparison and the inverse pullback realizations of the two factors. Exchange is the specified fixed compactification exchange conjugated by pullback/support realizations. LeftPath is g-star(PF);Exchange;f-prime-shriek(Mu followed by the restricted pullback-square comparison); RightPath is Mu; (Exchange tensor 1);PF-prime. Their common source comparison is pullRealization followed by the realized inverse fixed-pull comparison, the image of inverse-realized sourceComparison and the inverse coefficient-equivalence unit. Their common target comparison is targetComparison followed by the realized compact-support image of the tensor of the fixedPullRealization for g prime and the fixed f-prime pullback image of fixedPullRealization for g. The endpoints are the fixed-scalar diamond endpoints of [def-sf-finite-projection-exchange-coordinates]. These definitions are explicit composites; no arrow is chosen from an existence statement.
